'''Lerella Rosral''' was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Senoloro/Legends|Senoloro]] on [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Rosral served a life term in her position as governor, and was hated by her constituents for her autocratic policies.
